purpose: Return a bounded caller/callee neighborhood for one exact qualified symbol from the LIVE canonical RepositoryAnalysisState.module_usages[module].symbol_calls channel.
parameters: symbol (string, required): exact canonical module::symbol identity or active artifact ID (A/a prefix); plain unqualified leaves are rejected.
direction (callers|callees|both, default both): graph direction to traverse.
depth (integer 1-3, default 1): deterministic breadth-first traversal depth; booleans are invalid.
max_items (positive integer or null, default 20): global maximum emitted unique edges across the requested neighborhood; null requests every relevant edge before output protection.
representation (named|indexed|auto, default auto): control qualified names versus existing persistent artifact IDs.
allow_large_output (boolean, default false): explicitly approve the selected final payload when exact UTF-8 preflight exceeds 15360 bytes.
behavior: The graph is intra-module only. It does not claim inter-module symbol-call completeness or promote dynamic/ambiguous calls.

Active artifact IDs, including lowercase a-prefixed IDs, resolve exactly through the shared active canonical registry and then enter the unchanged canonical module::symbol pipeline. Missing syntactic IDs never use fuzzy matching.

A successful canonical module::symbol remains the first and cheapest textual path. Qualified textual misses may return bounded suggestion-only candidates from current, materialized, queryable active artifacts; fuzzy candidates never execute traversal and recovery identities are excluded.
Plain leaves remain unsupported even when a globally unique exact leaf exists in the shared resolver.
Traversal is deterministic BFS: nearer facts precede deeper facts, and canonical edge identities are deduplicated.
Named output is permitted only when the complete named candidate is at most 51200 UTF-8 bytes. Larger named candidates automatically select indexed output.
Auto selects indexed below the 51200-byte boundary only when existing shared representation policy saves at least 512 serialized bytes; otherwise it emits named output.
Indexed edges use existing persistent artifact IDs only and expose lookup_index_entries as the batch resolver. No new IDs or graph registry are created.

Representation negotiation happens before output auto-bounding: explicit named/indexed and auto selection remain authoritative, named candidates strictly above 51200 bytes force indexed representation, and auto switches to indexed at 512+ bytes savings.

After representation selection, the exact final JSON is measured against the 15360 UTF-8 byte threshold. When output exceeds 15360 bytes with allow_large_output=false and contains edges, the tool returns the largest deterministic edge prefix fitting within 15360 bytes (embedding _output.auto_bounded=true, full_output_bytes, requested_count, and returned_count). If even one edge cannot fit or returned_edges is zero, compact confirmation_required is returned without graph edges. No BFS, registry lookup, or canonical analysis is repeated for auto-bounding. Passing allow_large_output=true returns the complete original selected candidate.
freshness: Reads only current LIVE canonical module_usages symbol_calls. It performs no ast.parse, source read, grep, report parsing, or query-time graph reconstruction.
Fails closed when module truth is stale/unavailable or symbol_calls_materialized is false. A valid materialized-empty graph returns status ok with zero totals.

The response includes a ``state_freshness`` envelope scoped to the module containing the queried symbol:
- ``workspace_sync``: ``verified`` (sha256 matches), ``metadata_match`` (mtime+size only), ``out_of_sync`` (disk modified), or ``unverified``.
- ``canonical_revision``: Exact revision of the canonical state used to answer this query.
- ``provenance``: ``live`` or ``snapshot`` derived from engine hydration path.
- ``advisory_warning``: Non-null if the file is out of sync or the last analysis job was interrupted/failed.
errors: Unknown qualified symbols return controlled unknown_symbol or ambiguity responses with bounded suggestion-only candidates. Non-exact plain leaves, missing artifact IDs, invalid direction/depth/max_items/representation, missing indexed identities, stale truth, and unmaterialized call facts return controlled responses.
usage_notes: Start with direction, depth=1, and a small max_items. Use expand metadata or retry with a larger bound only when the refactor needs more context.

When _output.auto_bounded is true, inspect _output.full_output_bytes; when confirmation_required is returned, inspect estimated_output_bytes. In either case, repeat the identical request with allow_large_output=true to receive the complete original selected edge payload, or reduce max_items/depth.
